description: Search the whole supplement catalog by product name or brand. Typo-tolerant (e.g. "kreatine", "theanin" still match). Results are ordered by relevance, then cheapest normalized price-per-unit. Use find_cheapest instead when you already know the category.

category_slug.description: Optional: restrict results to this category and all of its subcategories, e.g. "protein-powder". Must be a slug from list_categories; an unknown slug is rejected.

in_stock_only.description: When true, only return products currently in stock.

limit.description: Maximum number of products to return (1-50).

market.description: Optional country market to query: nl, be. Defaults to the market of the requested domain. Any other value is rejected.

max_unit_price_cents.description: Optional: only return products whose normalized unit price is at or below this many cents.

query.description: The product name or brand to search for, e.g. "whey isolaat" or "magnesium bisglycinaat".

name: search_products
title: Search Products Tool
